description: This file contains a single exported function named resolveDaemonContainerContext that retrieves container context information from environment variables.

methods.name: export function resolveDaemonContainerContext( resolveDaemonContainerContext
methods.description: Retrieves and returns the container context string from environment variables, prioritizing OPENCLAW_CONTAINER_HINT and then OPENCLAW_CONTAINER, or returns null if neither is set.
